812-day streak as of 31 March 2025, started 9 January 2023 with Italian on a bus in Manchester. Used 14 streak
freezes in total, one of them for the night I fell asleep at 21:00 after the Nightjet. Super Duolingo family plan
split with Leonor and Dani, €9.99 each per year. Honest verdict: great for keeping the habit alive on lazy days, bad
for actually speaking. Owl guilt notifications at 22:47 are psychological warfare. Diamond league top 3 once, never
again, it ate a whole weekend. Real progress is tracked in [[Learning journal March]], and the stuff it never taught
me is in [[Italian false friends]].
